title: Registry gate accepted fetch through a destructured Window proxy alias
source: const { window: browserWindow } = globalThis; const request = browserWindow.fetch; request("https://collector.invalid/data");

reproduction.beforeFix: The source checker returned pass for a fetch alias after destructuring globalThis.window into a renamed binding.
reproduction.afterFix: The checker rejects destructured window, frames, and Document.defaultView aliases; the full contribution gate also rejects the representative destructured window source.

remediation: Resolve variable binding elements whose statically named property is a Window proxy member and whose initializer is already a trusted Window or Document reference.

validation.focusedRegression: 2 tests passed; three destructured Window/Document proxy variants rejected, with representative full contribution-gate rejection.
validation.auditAll: passed all 16 behavioral gates; scanned 324/324 canonical resources; built the 718-page Astro site and Sites Worker; bundle budgets, provenance, secret/security, and dependency audits passed.

deployment: not deployed; release-candidate verification remains open
